# Catchline

> A free, open-source browser extension (Chrome, Edge, Firefox) that matches the *, †, ‡ and ¹ markers on a promo page to their footnotes and lists the fees and conditions next to the claim. It runs entirely in the browser and makes no network requests.

## Try it

- [Web app](./app/): paste promo text or page HTML and see the catches. Runs in the browser, works offline, uploads nothing.

## Notes

- Licensed MIT. No accounts, analytics or telemetry.
- Accuracy on real pages has not been measured yet; the page says so instead of quoting a number.
